ValidationRule.description: Requires that before a deal is marked funded that the Residual assignment field is populated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordTypeId = "01280000000BZvi", ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Funded"), ISPICKVAL(Residual_Assigned_To__c, ""), DATEVALUE( Fund_Date__c) >= DATE(2012,11,06) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before a lease can be funded, the "Residual Assigned To" field must be populated.
